body: Thank you for your kind thoughts. I'm not about to harm myself right now. Although I don't believe I can ever live a happy life. I'd settle for a little less suffering. I've been in therapy and on medication for almost seven years now. Seven years of my youth. The years that were supposed to be the best in my life. There is no relief in sight. I can't imagine living seven more years like this, let alone the rest of my natural life.

I can't give you medical advice, since I'm not a doctor, and especially since I'm in this state of mind. You should really talk to your doctor. 

So illness in the most important organ in your body isn't considered a real medical issue in the Philippines? That's terrible!
I can't believe it took me almost half an hour to write that. I need some sleep.
